title: Connect your Google account
desktopDescription: Keep your notes on this computer and back them up to your own Google Drive.
webDescription: Sign in to open your NoteX library. Notes are kept in this browser and backed up to your Google Drive.
storageError: NoteX could not open this library. Your data has not been reset.

errors.GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in is not configured in this build yet.
errors.GOOGLE_NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach Google. Check your connection and try again.
errors.GOOGLE_POPUP_BLOCKED: Allow the Google sign-in popup, then try again.
errors.GOOGLE_AUTH_CANCELLED: Sign-in was cancelled. Your library has not changed.
errors.GOOGLE_AUTH_TIMEOUT: Sign-in timed out. Please try again.
errors.GOOGLE_DRIVE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Allow NoteX to store its backups in Google Drive to continue.
errors.GOOGLE_REAUTHORIZE: Authorize Google again to continue your backups.
errors.GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: Choose the Google account connected to this library.
errors.LOCAL_SAVE_PENDING: Some changes have not been saved locally. Finish saving before changing accounts.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOTE_CONFLICT: A local note and an account note have the same version but different content. Both copies have been preserved.
errors.GOOGLE_TOKEN_ERROR: Google authorization was received, but NoteX could not obtain an access token. Check the desktop OAuth configuration and try again.
errors.GOOGLE_DESKTOP_SECRET_REQUIRED: Google sign-in requires additional desktop app configuration. Your local notes have been preserved.
errors.GOOGLE_CLIENT_INVALID: Google rejected the desktop OAuth credentials. Check that the client ID and client secret belong to the same Desktop app client.
errors.GOOGLE_PROFILE_ERROR: NoteX could not verify your Google account. Try signing in again.
errors.GOOGLE_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_ERROR: NoteX could not save your Google sign-in in Windows Credential Manager. Your local notes have been preserved.
errors.GOOGLE_SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Secure storage for Google sign-in is not available on this system.
errors.GOOGLE_AUTH_INVALID_CALLBACK: The Google sign-in response was incomplete. Start sign-in again.
errors.GOOGLE_CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE: NoteX could not open the local Google sign-in callback. Restart the app and try again.
errors.GOOGLE_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE: NoteX could not open your browser. Check your default browser and try again.
errors.generic: Could not complete this operation. Your local notes have been preserved.
